import re


def run(ctx, invoice, po, **params):
    """Check one vendor invoice against its purchase order; log it; flag mismatches."""
    text = ctx.read_text("invoice")
    number = re.search(r"Invoice number:\s*(\S+)", text).group(1)
    po_number = re.search(r"PO number:\s*(\S+)", text).group(1)
    vendor = text.splitlines()[0].strip()
    tokens = [t.strip() for t in text.splitlines() if t.strip()]
    orders = ctx.read_table("po")
    lines = orders[orders["po_number"] == po_number]

    issues = []
    for _, row in lines.iterrows():
        i = tokens.index(row["sku"])  # SKU, description, qty, unit price, amount
        qty, price = int(tokens[i + 2]), float(tokens[i + 3])
        if qty != int(row["qty"]):
            issues.append({"sku": row["sku"], "field": "qty", "po": int(row["qty"]), "invoice": qty})
        if abs(price - float(row["unit_price"])) > 0.005:
            issues.append({"sku": row["sku"], "field": "unit_price",
                           "po": float(row["unit_price"]), "invoice": price})

    status = "mismatch" if issues else "matched"
    note = "; ".join(f"{i['sku']} {i['field']} {i['invoice']} vs PO {i['po']}" for i in issues)
    ctx.action("tracker.upsert", ref=number, vendor=vendor, status=status, note=note)
    if issues:
        ctx.action("slack.post", channel="#warehouse",
                   text=f"{number} ({vendor}) does not match {po_number}: {note}")
        ctx.action("jira.create", summary=f"{number} mismatch vs {po_number}", description=note)
    return {"summary": f"{number} from {vendor}: {status}" + (f" ({note})" if note else ""),
            "tables": {"issues": issues}}

import pandas as pd

PO = pd.DataFrame([{"po_number": "PO-1", "sku": "A", "qty": 10, "unit_price": 2.0}])
TEXT = "Vendor\nInvoice number: INV-1\nPO number: PO-1\nA\nWidget\n12\n2.00\n24.00\n"


def test_flags_quantity_over_po():
    ctx = FakeCtx(tables={"po": PO}, texts={"invoice": TEXT})
    out = run(ctx, invoice="invoice", po="po")
    assert out["tables"]["issues"] == [{"sku": "A", "field": "qty", "po": 10, "invoice": 12}]
    assert [a["kind"] for a in ctx.actions] == ["tracker.upsert", "slack.post", "jira.create"]


def test_clean_invoice_only_logs():
    ctx = FakeCtx(tables={"po": PO}, texts={"invoice": TEXT.replace("\n12\n", "\n10\n")})
    run(ctx, invoice="invoice", po="po")
    assert [a["kind"] for a in ctx.actions] == ["tracker.upsert"]

# Invoice check and notify

## What it does
Checks each vendor invoice against its purchase order, logs it in the tracker, and flags mismatches to the warehouse team. Steps: read the invoice PDF; match lines against the PO; log it in the tracker; flag mismatches in Slack and Jira.

## What's automated
- Read new invoices from the inbox
- Extract invoice number, lines and totals from the PDF
- Match against the reference table
- Check quantities and prices against the PO
- Add or update the tracker row

## What needs your approval
- Post an alert in Slack
- Open a Jira ticket for the mismatch

## What you give it
- **invoice**: a file (the invoice PDF from the inbox)
- **po**: a file (the purchase-order table)

## What you get back
table issues.

## Example
Run it with invoice = inv-2202.pdf and po = po.xlsx: INV-2202 from Acme Packaging bills 165 × AC-14 but PO-4102 ordered 150, so the tracker row is marked mismatch and a Slack alert and Jira ticket wait for your approval.

## Permissions used
- read and send email
- update the tracker
- post messages in Slack
- open Jira tickets

## How to undo or delete
Every confirmed run can be undone from the tool page. Delete the tool any time; ToolSmith may suggest it again later unless you choose "Don't suggest again".

## Limits
Only handles inputs shaped like the ones it was built from; anything else stops with a clear error instead of guessing.
